Q.name: Broken Wings
Q.title: Template:Data Riven/Broken Wings
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Broken Wings|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Riven
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Broken Wings.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Riven}} can cast this ability up to three times in quick succession, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
* {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Riven''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} forward and slashes her sword in a circle.
* {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Riven''' mimics the first cast.
* {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Riven''' mimics the first cast's dash, but now slams her sword in a larger circle, briefly {{tip|airborne|knocking back}} enemies hit as well.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' can activate ''Broken Wings'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a {{fd|0.3125}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts. If '''Riven''' does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown. 
|description2 = '''Riven''' slashes with her sword for each of the three casts, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies struck within an area, {{tip|Basic attack reset|resetting}} her basic attack timer, and ordering her to basic attack the target of ''Broken Wings'' if there are any.
|leveling2    = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|45 to 165}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60 to 80}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|45*3 to 165*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*3 to 80*3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description3  = {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Riven''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} 225 units in the direction she is currently facing, or up to 225 units towards the target enemy, striking enemies in the target area 100 units away. This cast cannot cross terrain.
|description4 = {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Riven''' mimics the first cast's effects.
|description5 = {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Riven''' mimics the first cast's effects in a larger area while also {{tip|airborne|knocking back}} enemies hit 75 units over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. This cast can cross terrain.
|cooldown     = {{tt|13|Starts after first cast}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|150}}|First/second cast standard radius}}|{{tt|250|Third cast standard radius}}|{{tt|200|First/second cast enhanced radius during Blade of the Exile}}|{{tt|300|Third cast enhanced radius during Blade of the Exile}}}}
|terraingrace = true
|targeting    = {{dv|[[Auto-targeted|Auto]]|[[Unit-targeted|Unit]]}}
|affects      = Enemies
|cast time = none
|damagetype   = physical
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|onhiteffects = 
|grounded     = true
|spellshield  = true
|knockdown    = true
|outofrange   = The ability will cast in the direction of the targeted enemy regardless of range
|notes        = 
{{always quickcast}}
* Each cast counts as a single ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* Moving after using ''Broken Wings'' allows Riven to do other actions faster.
* The {{sbc|Third Cast}} prevents '''Riven''' from using basic attacks and abilities for longer than the other 2 casts.
* The {{sbc|Third Cast}} may have an extended dash range when crossing terrain.
* The {{sbc|Third Cast's}} {{tip|airborne|knockup}} debuff is not removed early if the forced movement is interrupted.
* Any forced movement affecting the target being knocked up is {{tip|knockdown|interrupted}} when the {{tip|airborne|knockup}} debuff is removed.{{bug|2|this is not the case for most other knockups}}
}}

{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Blade of the Exile|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Riven |skill = R |icon = Blade of the Exile.png |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Riven}} empowers her blade for some time, gaining {{sti|ad|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and increased {{sti|range}} on her {{tip|basic attacks}}, ''{{ai|Broken Wings|Riven}}'' and ''{{ai|Ki Burst|Riven}}''. |blurb2 = During this time, '''Riven''' can cast ''{{ai|Wind Slash|Riven}}''. |post-blurb = Riven/Wind Slash |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' empowers her blade for 15 seconds, gaining {{as|20% AD}} {{sti|ad|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' attack range}}, and increased range on ''{{ai|Broken Wings|Riven}}'' and ''{{ai|Ki Burst|Riven}}''.

After {{fd|0.5}} seconds, she can cast ''{{ai|Wind Slash|Riven}}'' within the duration. |cooldown = {{ap|120 to 60}} |cdstart = post-effect |targeting = Auto |affects = Self |damagetype = |projectile = |cast time = {{fd|0.25}} |spelleffects = |onhiteffects = |spellshield = |notes = * All bonuses are gained after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the ability starting its cast. ** The {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} amount is factored upon cast, and does not change. * If '''Riven''' has a basic attack buffered before the end of ''Blade of the Exile's'' cast time, the buffered basic attack will start {{fd|0.33}} seconds after the end of the cast time. ** The delay will not apply to basic attack commands input after ''Blade of the Exile's'' cast time. |flavorsound = {{sm2|Riven_Original_R_0.ogg}} ''"I am awakened."'' }}
